title.zh: Bitmine nears 5% of Ethereum supply after buying 28,086 ETH
title.en: Bitmine nears 5% of Ethereum supply after buying 28,086 ETH

current_state.zh: BitMine 持有 593 万 ETH，其中 507 万 ETH 已质押，约占以太坊活跃质押量的 11.8%，但 validator 与签名密钥的控制权分布仍未披露。
current_state.en: BitMine holds 5.93 million ETH, with 5.07 million ETH staked, representing about 11.8% of Ethereum's active stake, while the distribution of validators and signing-key control remains undisclosed.

updates.title_zh: BitMine’s staked ETH equals nearly 12% of Ethereum’s active stake, but who controls it?
updates.title_en: BitMine’s staked ETH equals nearly 12% of Ethereum’s active stake, but who controls it?
updates.what_changed_zh: BitMine 已质押 507 万 ETH（约占其 593 万 ETH 持有量的 85%），相当于以太坊活跃质押量的约 11.8%；同时结束与 Ethereum Tower 的管理服务协议，并任命关联公司 American Validator 为 MAVAN Holdings 提供咨询。
updates.what_changed_en: BitMine has staked 5.07 million ETH (~85% of its 5.93 million ETH holdings), equal to roughly 11.8% of Ethereum's active stake, and ended its management-services agreement with Ethereum Tower while appointing affiliate American Validator to advise MAVAN Holdings.
updates.current_state_zh: BitMine 持有 593 万 ETH，其中 507 万 ETH 已质押，约占以太坊活跃质押量的 11.8%，但 validator 与签名密钥的控制权分布仍未披露。
updates.current_state_en: BitMine holds 5.93 million ETH, with 5.07 million ETH staked, representing about 11.8% of Ethereum's active stake, while the distribution of validators and signing-key control remains undisclosed.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: BitMine Immersion Technologies has staked 5.07 million ETH, roughly 11.8% of Ethereum's active stake, but has not disclosed how its validators or signing keys are distributed.
updates.detailed_summary_en: BitMine Immersion Technologies has staked 5.07 million ETH, roughly 11.8% of Ethereum's active stake, but has not disclosed how its validators or signing keys are distributed.
